g.title: WebAgentStep
g.text: One WebAgent step: paired observation, write-ahead execution, and durable commit

g.title: start
g.text: (stop immediately if the task deadline passed)

g.title: observe
g.text: viewport PNG + rendered viewport/document context + bound refs

g.title: challenge
g.text: headless or fail mode: fail closed

g.title: pre
g.text: step_NNN/pre.json + pre.png; register observation with policy

g.title: blocked
g.text: close browser, except isolated search-only reset retains it

g.title: reobserve
g.text: Re-observe stable page after human resolution

g.title: plan
g.text: loop/strategy state + bounded history + exposed schemas
repair invalid planner output within the attempt budget

g.title: no_call
g.text: write not-attempted post evidence; update failure count; checkpoint

g.title: write_ahead
g.text: assess replay policy -> set pending_action -> persist before execution

g.title: post_state
g.text: wait and re-observe; done marks the pre-state as reused

g.title: record
g.text: failure tracking + AgentStep/history + hooks + strategy update

g.title: commit
g.text: clear pending_action + persist next_step and recovery state
